summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests CRD3874-SI, a STING agonist, in people with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia. How the drug is given, how often, and for how long are not stated in the record. The record says the study aims to find out whether CRD3874-SI is safe, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa CRD3874-SI, un agonista de STING, en personas con leucemia mieloide aguda recidivante o refractaria. La forma de administración, la frecuencia y la duración no se indican en el registro. El registro indica que el estudio busca saber si CRD3874-SI es seguro, y la medida de resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory AML, using the record's stated definitions.
Age 18 years or older at consent.
Organ function within stated limits, including ejection fraction of 50% or higher.
not_for: Acute promyelocytic leukemia or isolated myeloid sarcoma.
Blast phase of chronic myeloid leukemia or known active CNS leukemia.
Active graft versus host disease of grade 2 or higher needing systemic treatment.
Symptomatic or recently treated autoimmune disease, or clinically significant immunosuppression.
Significant cardiac disease within 6 months, or QTcF of 470 ms or higher.
